title: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit
notes: Exact IPA SHA-256 023d477f407ade2320be66c6ac973ece86a07bc00195a239238f1862623f4bf1. On POCO ARM64, the upright intro, tutorial, pause and Career menus responded. Cop Events > Priority Target started a real Interceptor race; the timer and bounty changed, a touch deployed Roadblock, and the event reached a normal FAILED result after time expired. Tap to Continue returned to Career with $3,210 earned. After Android force-stop and fresh launch, Resume Cop Career reopened the event map. This is partial: physical tilt steering, successful interception, audible audio, exact bounty persistence after relaunch, long-session performance and complete optional true-widescreen HUD are not proven. The optional wide patch remains off by default; this is the iPhone 1.0.3 IPA, not the HD iPad version.

testedOn.profile: iPhone 3GS; exact landscape-left patch; true widescreen off

reviewedUserReports.notes: ARM64 Release build on POCO X3 NFC (Android 12). Upright intro and TAP TO CONTINUE led to an interactive 3D tutorial race, with visible police car, road, speed HUD and changing frames for at least 100 seconds after Nitro. Holding lower-left brake and upward swipe advanced tutorial prompts; upper-left pause/resume worked. Earlier grey screen did not recur. Tilt steering, handbrake, race completion, audible sound, long play and optional true-widescreen patch were NOT verified; the widescreen intro can clip text and remains disabled by default. Partial, not full-game approval.
